title: How fast does each heart beat?
prompt: Place each one by its resting heart rate, slowest to fastest.

items.label: A blue whale
items.fact: While diving, a blue whale’s heart can slow to just 8 beats a minute.

items.label: An elephant
items.fact: Bigger animals generally have slower hearts.

items.label: A resting human
items.fact: A typical resting adult heart beats 60–100 times a minute.

items.label: A house cat
items.fact: A cat's heart races at roughly twice a human's.

items.label: A mouse
items.fact: Tiny bodies burn energy fast, driving very quick heartbeats.

items.label: A hummingbird
items.fact: In flight, a hummingbird heart can exceed 1,200 beats a minute.
